title: EOS Classification Catalog Entry
description: Standalone Reference Catalog Entry Aggregate Root defining one system-neutral CLS meaning with lifecycle, audit metadata and definition provenance. Version 1 defines no classification-system, external-code, hierarchy, alias, equivalence or target-applicability semantics.

id.description: Stable identity of exactly one Classification Catalog Entry. It is not the identity of an embedded Classification assignment, classification system or external code.

sourceLinks.description: Provenance of the catalog definition. Provenance of assigning this classification belongs to the embedded Classification value object.

name.description: Canonical human-readable label. It is not identity and is not structurally unique.

description.description: Authoritative human-readable definition of the classification meaning. It is not machine-readable hierarchy, system, external-code, equivalence or applicability data.

replaces.description: Optional reference to one older Classification Catalog Entry replaced by this entry. It is not a hierarchy or equivalence edge.

replacedBy.description: Optional reference to one newer Classification Catalog Entry that replaces this entry. It is not a hierarchy or equivalence edge.
